release_note: This sidecar carries ONLY column metadata + balance coefficients; it contains NO iTrust/SWaT data rows and the rows cannot be reconstructed from anything committed in this repository. The controlled-access rows themselves stay in the untracked research/ quarantine and are never redistributed (raw or derived). Naming the dataset is required credit per the iTrust usage agreement, not redistribution.
description: SWaT stage-1 raw-water tank T101 volume (mass) balance witness on a real water-treatment testbed; LIT101 sensor-spoofing attacks break the closure.

provenance.citation: Goh, Adepu, Junejo, Mathur, 'A Dataset to Support Research in the Design of Secure Water Treatment Systems', CRITIS 2016
provenance.license: iTrust usage agreement; data NOT redistributed in this repository
provenance.note: Kaggle packaging (normal.csv + attack.csv) reconstructed into a continuous normal-with-attacks sequence; 30 s aggregation; segment joins bridged (only within-segment level changes enter the balance).

balance.definition: residual = dLIT101 - factor*(FIT101 - FIT201) [mm per 30 s block]; ~0 under normal control, jumps when a spoofed LIT101 contradicts the metered net flow

fault.mode: cyber-attacks spoofing LIT101 (and stage-1 flow) -- level frozen/biased while the flow meters keep moving
fault.note: multiple disjoint labelled windows; only stage-1 (LIT101/flow) attacks break the T101 balance
